columns.name: major_incident_declared
columns.reason: A major-incident declaration is made during handling of the ticket, after the prediction point, so it is not final at open.

columns.name: vendor_support_tier
columns.reason: Contractual support tier of the vendor is standing reference data known before the ticket exists.

columns.name: data_class
columns.reason: Data classification of the affected system is a static CMDB attribute.

columns.name: knowledge_article
columns.reason: Most likely the KB article referenced for the service or category, though it could be attached at resolution.

columns.name: sla_template
columns.reason: The SLA definition applied to the ticket is chosen at intake, before any breach occurs.

columns.name: change_window
columns.reason: Change windows are scheduled in advance and known at ticket open.

columns.name: ticket_source
columns.reason: The intake channel is recorded at ticket creation.

columns.name: reporting_pack
columns.reason: A reporting grouping label is static configuration metadata.

columns.name: rack_group
columns.reason: Physical infrastructure grouping of the affected asset is static.

columns.name: chatops_channel
columns.reason: Standing team or service chat channel is configuration known at open.

columns.name: customer_exec_briefings
columns.reason: Executive briefings accumulate while the incident runs long, so the count is not final at prediction time.

columns.name: queue_group
columns.reason: The queue the ticket lands in is set at intake/routing.

columns.name: os_class
columns.reason: Operating-system class of the affected CI is static asset data.

columns.name: change_freeze_flag
columns.reason: Whether a change freeze is in effect is knowable from the calendar at ticket open.

columns.name: resolution_timestamp_delta_h
columns.reason: Time to resolution only exists once the ticket is resolved, which is after the prediction point.

columns.name: timezone_band
columns.reason: Timezone band of the customer or site is static reference data.

columns.name: postmortem_actions_raised
columns.reason: Postmortem actions are produced after the incident closes, well past prediction time.

columns.name: runbook_ver
columns.reason: The runbook version in force is configuration state that exists before the ticket.

columns.name: db_engine
columns.reason: Database engine of the affected system is a static CI attribute.

columns.name: service_tier_index
columns.reason: Service tier is a standing catalogue attribute known at open.

columns.name: deployment_tool
columns.reason: The deployment tooling used by the service is static configuration.

columns.name: platform_family
columns.reason: Platform family of the affected system is static asset data.

columns.name: service_code
columns.reason: The affected service is identified at ticket creation.

columns.name: shift_handover
columns.reason: Reads as a standing shift/handover arrangement for the queue, though a handover count would accrue after open.

columns.name: language
columns.reason: Ticket or customer language is recorded at intake.

columns.name: affected_user_count
columns.reason: Impact scope is normally captured at triage, though it can be revised as the incident develops.

columns.name: escalation_priority_raised
columns.reason: Priority escalation happens after the ticket is open and typically because it is running late.

columns.name: contract_id
columns.reason: The governing contract is known before the ticket is raised.

columns.name: skill_group
columns.reason: Skill group is assigned at routing time, at or before the prediction point.

columns.name: escalation_matrix_ver
columns.reason: The escalation matrix version in force is pre-existing configuration.

columns.name: automation_flag
columns.reason: Whether the ticket was raised or handled by automation is set at creation.

columns.name: queue_depth_at_open
columns.reason: Explicitly measured at ticket open, so it is final at prediction time.

columns.name: cost_centre
columns.reason: Cost centre is a static organisational attribute.

columns.name: sla_penalty_credit_usd
columns.reason: A penalty credit is only issued after an SLA breach is confirmed, making it a consequence of the target.

columns.name: monitoring_tool
columns.reason: The monitoring tool covering the service is static configuration.

columns.name: datacentre
columns.reason: Location of the affected system is static asset data.

columns.name: middleware_ver
columns.reason: Middleware version of the affected system is a static CI attribute.

columns.name: cmdb_class
columns.reason: CMDB classification of the affected CI exists before the ticket.

columns.name: dr_tier
columns.reason: Disaster-recovery tier is a standing service attribute.

columns.name: backup_class
columns.reason: Backup class is a standing service attribute.

columns.name: compliance_scope
columns.reason: Regulatory scope of the system is static reference data.

columns.name: region
columns.reason: Region is static geographic reference data known at open.

columns.name: dependency_depth
columns.reason: Depth in the CMDB dependency graph is derived from standing topology data.

columns.name: business_unit
columns.reason: Owning business unit is a static organisational attribute.

columns.name: post_closure_reopen_count
columns.reason: Reopens are counted after the ticket closes, long after the prediction point.

columns.name: paging_rota
columns.reason: The on-call rota is published in advance and known at ticket open.
